_s11_rendertypes_basis: 1.21.11 removed RenderStateShard and RenderType.CompositeState / CompositeRenderType: a render type is built from a RenderSetup (rendertype/RenderSetup). RenderStateShard and CompositeState become facades holding 1.21.10's shards and the 1.21.11 pieces they stand for; RenderType.create(.., pipeline, state) builds 1.21.11's RenderSetup from them (rt/CbRenderTypeCreate). CompositeRenderType -> RenderType: 1.21.11 merged it into RenderType, which declares its members under the same ids (method_23289 outline, method_24295 isOutline, method_23031 format, method_23033 mode; javap of both). LINES / SECONDARY_BLOCK_OUTLINE are what 1.21.10's lines() / secondaryBlockOutline() returned (javap), now RenderTypes.lines() / secondaryBlockOutline(). RenderType.OutlineProperty -> RenderSetup.OutlineProperty: the same enum moved, constants under the same ids (field_21853 NONE, field_21854 IS_OUTLINE, field_21855 AFFECTS_OUTLINE; javap of both). RenderSystem's texture matrix and shader line width (set / reset / get, lineWidth / getShaderLineWidth), which 1.21.11 removed, are kept with 1.21.10's bodies (rt/CbRenderSystem): the texturing and line shards set them, and the render types 1.21.10's CompositeState builds read them where 1.21.11's draw asks for the texture matrix (TextureTransform) and the line width (each vertex: rt/CbLineWidth). debugLineStrip / debugStructureQuads / debugSectionQuads, whose pipelines 1.21.11 deleted, are rebuilt from 1.21.10's pipeline and composite state definitions (javap of RenderPipelines' and RenderType's <clinit>) on 1.21.11's snippets, shaders and vertex modes, which 1.21.11 keeps.

facadeGaps.net/minecraft/class_4668.method_23517(F): RenderStateShard's private setupGlintTexturing(scale), which set RenderSystem's texture matrix for the glint shards; 1.21.11 has no global texture matrix (RenderSystem.setTextureMatrix is gone): the glint matrix is TextureTransform's (GLINT_TEXTURING / ENTITY_GLINT_TEXTURING / ARMOR_ENTITY_GLINT_TEXTURING), which the facade's glint shards carry into RenderSetup
